name: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Limited
summary: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells organic, inorganic and effect pigments, performance colorants, pearlescent pigments, and specialty chemicals in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Pigments and Others. The company offers architectural, automotive, floor, industrial, wood, coil, glass, and powder coating products, as well as area marking and traffic paints; pigment solutions for personal care, stationary, cosmetics, automotive, consumer goods, packaging, construction and electrical, and fiber; and liquid, paste, and specialty printing inks.
